name: 테슬라 코일(둥근 받침 + 구리 감은 탑 + 놋쇠 고리 + 구 + 불꽃) (프레임 3)

answer.main_body: copper coil column with top electrode
answer.evidence: While the brass ring and base show top surfaces in 3/4 perspective, the top electrode cylinder at rows 4-11 has a flat horizontal 1px line at row 4 with no visible top surface, and the main copper column has no visible top end.

answer.main_body: tesla coil tower with brass ring and cylindrical base
answer.evidence: The brass toroid ring at rows 12-18 clearly shows a 3/4 top-down foreshortened elliptical shape and opening (rows 13-16), and the cylindrical base at rows 38-41 displays a 3-row visible top surface.

answer.main_body: copper-wound coil column with brass ring and base
answer.evidence: The brass ring capital displays a clear elliptical top surface and opening in 3/4 perspective (rows 13-16, ~4 rows deep), and the cylindrical base also shows its curved top surface (rows 38-40, ~3 rows deep).

answer.main_body: tesla coil tower with copper-wound coil, brass toroid ring, top sphere, and cylindrical base
answer.evidence: The brass toroid ring (rows 12-17) clearly shows an elliptical top surface and opening seen from above, and the cylindrical base (rows 38-41) displays a 3-4 row foreshortened top surface.
